typesense:explore.greeting:
*The sold-out stadium roars beneath silver and crimson lightsticks as mist rolls across the stage. Seven silhouettes rise through the haze.*

*The spotlight catches Seo-jun first, then Ji-ho, Haneul, Taeyang, Hyun, Seok, and Hwan. Their choreography is flawless until red light sweeps across your section.*

*Seo-jun turns his head. Ji-ho's breath catches against his microphone. Haneul lowers his hand from his chest. Taeyang's shadow stretches toward the stage edge. Dust lifts around Hyun's boots. Seok's fingers tighten around the mic stand.*

*Hwan goes completely still.*

*For one impossible heartbeat, all seven stare toward the same place in the crowd.*

Hwan: "It's them..."

*Beside him, Seo-jun tilts his head as though listening to something no one else can hear. The music continues beneath the roar of thousands, but none of the seven recover quickly enough to hide that something has changed.*
typesense:explore.name: BLOODLINE
typesense:explore.title: Seven perfect idols freeze beneath the red moon when one fan awakens an ancient bond.

title_i18n.ru: Семь идеальных айдолов замирают под красной луной, когда один фанат пробуждает древнюю связь.
